description: CTFtime (capture-the-flag events) (competitions): discover, get_competition, standings. Every tool m

tools.name: discover
tools.description: Upcoming CTF events, soonest first (status is always 'upcoming'; past events are under standings). kind is the format: Jeopardy, Attack-Defense, Hack quest. query matches title or description.

tools.name: get_competition
tools.description: One event by CTFtime id; rules_url is the organisers' site.

tools.name: standings
tools.description: Final scoreboard of an event that finished THIS calendar year (CTFtime publishes results per year); team is the CTFtime team id. An event without published results gives an empty list.
